title: Proof theory for sequent-style tableaux: G0- and G3-style sequent calculi and full normalization
summary: Sequent-style tableaux are a one-sided refutation calculus for classical propositional logic, in which each node of the refutation tree carries a finite block of formulae and the structural rules are absorbed into the data structure and the closure criterion.
